Description: Dameokja dev SLI log metrics, SLO burn-rate alarms and dashboard

InstanceId.Description: CloudWatch Agent가 설치된 앱 서버 인스턴스 ID

RootFsType.Description: Agent disk_used_percent의 fstype 차원 값(콘솔 지표에서 확인)

Properties.AlarmDescription: 전체 API 5xx가 5분간 기준 건수 이상(SLI 비대상 API 포함 일반 오류 감시)
앱 서버 메모리 사용률 90% 이상 10분 지속(CloudWatch Agent)
앱 서버 루트 디스크 사용률 85% 이상(로그 증가 감시)

Properties.Name: dameokja-dev/SLO 작업별 응답 코드 건수
Properties.QueryString:
filter route != "-"
| fields floor(status / 100) as class
| stats count(*) as requests by route, class
| sort route, class

Properties.Name: dameokja-dev/4xx 코드별 건수
Properties.QueryString:
filter status >= 400 and status < 500
| stats count(*) as requests by status, route
| sort requests desc

Properties.Name: dameokja-dev/API 서버 처리시간 p95·p99(보조, nginx request_time)
Properties.QueryString:
filter route != "-" and (status < 400 or status >= 500)
| stats count(*) as requests, pct(request_time, 95) as p95_sec, pct(request_time, 99) as p99_sec by route

Properties.Name: dameokja-dev/아침 알림 배치 결과
Properties.QueryString:
filter @message like /알림 생성 단계를 마쳤습니다/
| parse @message "refrigeratorCount=*, failedRefrigeratorCount=*, elapsedMillis=*" as total, failed, elapsed
| fields @timestamp, total, failed, elapsed
| sort @timestamp desc

Properties.Name: dameokja-dev/Push 발송 실패 로그
Properties.QueryString:
filter @message like /푸시를 전송하지 못했습니다|Web Push 전송에 실패했습니다|푸시 발송 작업을 처리하지 못했습니다/
| stats count(*) as failures by bin(1h)
